name: davanstrien/saturate
title: Eight open OCR models compared on 850 pages: $0.51 down to $0.095 per 1,000 pages
summary: A Hugging Face engineer ran eight open OCR models from the last 18 months on the same 850 pages on one GPU and reports cost per 1,000 pages falling from $0.51 to $0.095. The follow-up post links a Hugging Face Space to run the cheapest model on your own pages and the vLLM batch tool used.

appearances.title: Saturate batches models over datasets
appearances.summary: Saturate runs a model over a dataset or bucket through any OpenAI-compatible endpoint and chooses its own concurrency. On Hugging Face Jobs, one GPU re-OCR'd 14,483 pages at 8.9 pages per second once the job was running, for $1.47.
